x: A "ghost" Belgrave team ran in the Wimbledon '10' on the day of the Southern London-Brighton relay and finished 10th. Jack Brown was 27th in 55:18 Norman Stairs 36th in 56:17, Pete Sadler 38th in 56:23 and Bob Glover 46th in 57:12.
It will be interesting to see how he progresses. Following Vaughan home were, Brian Nott, Dave Cocks, Jackie Hampshire and Pete Sadler.

Denis Jones also had a good day,gaining 20 places on the final lap,but Peter Sadler,after showing early promise,was forced to withdraw. The race is held from the AEC works,Southall,and is well organised with a free "binge"to follow.

John Hilton finished in his best time to date in front of Charlie Walker and Pete Sadler who were well up at one point but fell away towards the end Reg Hopkins and Wally Wortley completed our ten finishers.

Bicourt and Hart were always well placed, with Mike Shingles making ground close behind. Dave Cocks and Pete Sadler disappointed and it was left to John Dear to complete our scoring four after a fine run in 59th place.
Pete Sadler,Norman Stairs and John Hilton finished 16th,18th and 37th with times of 56:24,56:42 and 61:39 respectively,all of which qualify towards 2nd class standards.
